'''Kayson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who ran [[Kayson's Weapons Shop]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He had a sour disposition and atrocious manners. He was a hulking ape-like humanoid with short fur, four nostrils, and an optical enhancer worn over his left eye.

[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] ago, the entrepreneur [[Meysen Kayson]] found Kayson as an abandoned child in Mos Eisley on Tatooine. Meysen Kayson raised the child and taught him about his previous profession, that of a [[Smuggler/Legends|gun runner]]. When the child eventually matured, he took Kayson's name as his own.<ref name="GWH">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref>
